summary: Frontend Software Developer with 4 years of UK experience and 10+ years working with websites and web technologies overall. I mainly work with React, TypeScript, Next.js and Ionic, building internal tools, dashboards and mobile apps that people use for real business workflows. I am comfortable working independently, taking a feature from an initial idea through to implementation, testing, deployment and ongoing support.

items: Building a new internal Next.js 16 dashboard with React, TypeScript, Prisma ORM and MariaDB, connecting company workflows with Business Central ERP data.
Built the main foundations for the platform, including authentication, permissions, multi-company support, internationalisation/localisation, theming, caching and shared npm workspace packages.
Set up CI/CD with GitHub Actions for the dashboard so builds and deployments are more repeatable, with less manual work and fewer chances for release errors.

Improved how user sessions are handled by adding JWT short-lived tokens, token rotation and permission-based checks, helping protect ERP-linked company data and meet external GDPR/security review requirements.
Maintain 3 production Ionic apps on iOS and Android: 2 B2B apps that share a similar structure, and 1 B2C dropshipping app.

Build mobile app features with Ionic 8, Capacitor 8, React 19 and TypeScript, including barcode scanning, order/customer workflows, REST API integration and Firebase push notifications across the B2B and B2C apps.
Maintain an internal barcode generation app used to create unique product barcodes and prevent duplicate assignments.
Use Sentry, Firebase Analytics and Cypress E2E tests to find issues earlier and make key app flows more reliable.
Built small business websites and provided practical IT support for local clients.
Worked on WordPress sites and plugins, covering both frontend changes and backend fixes.
Built e-commerce and company websites with WordPress, WooCommerce and custom plugins.
Helped local clients with IT support, troubleshooting and day-to-day technical issues.
